134169800.title: File:1.5V Lithium Battery Charger and Cable Top Picture.png

ObjectName.value: 1.5V Lithium Battery Charger and Cable Top Picture

ImageDescription.value:
Picture of a 1.5 volts rechargeable lithium battery charger, and its cable. The charger is black and rectangular. It is seen from above. Around the center of the top face of the charger, a small USB-C port can be seen.
On the right of the picture is a black USB-C power cable, attached by a black cord. Its two ends are pointing toward the charger in the picture.
